verbatim_excerpt: Math. Program. 104(2-3):669-700, published 14 July 2005, issue date November 2005. 'This theory ensures an efficient computation of generalized (lexicographic) derivative of a nonsmooth function belonging to a special class of lexicographically smooth functions... it is shown that the system of lexicographic derivatives along a fixed basis correctly represents corresponding nonsmooth function (Newton-Leibnitz formula)... an appropriately defined lexicographic subdifferential ensures a more rigorous selection of a candidate optimal solution than the subdifferential of Clarke.'
